title: Quantitative research baseline and reproducibility standard
objective: Establish a governed quantitative-research baseline and audit the legacy research path without searching for or selecting a better strategy.
success_criteria: Research claims require immutable data provenance and chronological development/validation/test separation
The baseline contract rejects look-ahead, synthetic one-sided loss clipping, train/test contamination and undeclared parameter trials
Legacy Champion and M005 evidence limitations are recorded without changing or optimizing either strategy
stop_conditions: Any change outside rnd/ or to frozen/operational paths
Any optimization, ranking or selection of a new trading strategy
Any broker, execution, strategy/risk/sizing, merge, promotion or capital authority
